title: Senior Platform Software Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
About Us:
  
  
At Oracle, we are transforming healthcare by modernizing Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems to empower front-line healthcare professionals. Our mission is to enable them to focus more on patient care and less on administrative tasks, achieving peak efficiency with the support of generative AI and modernized applications. By leveraging the power of generative AI and state-of-the-art applications, we aim to enhance efficiency and effectiveness in healthcare delivery. Our approach to modernization includes investing in cutting-edge AI capabilities, advancing user experience, and offering open APIs that enable customers and third parties to develop innovative, integrated solutions. We are dedicated to creating a seamless and intuitive healthcare experience that benefits patients, providers, payers, and the entire healthcare ecosystem.
  
  
Our Mission: At Oracle Health, we prioritize humans in the healthcare experience—for patients, providers, payers, and the population. We advance healthcare and population-level health by making cutting-edge solutions practical and effective at the practitioner level. Our goal is to enable patients to receive care from anyone, anywhere, on any device by providing practitioners with comprehensive medical information.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
As a Full stack Software Engineer, you will work with Product/Design during the design phase, author a technical approach to building the features, and breakdown, refine, and deliver the work with your team. The ideal candidate will be passionate, self-motivated, able to multitask effectively, and have strong communication skills. This individual will be autonomous and be expected to contribute to a wide range of high-impact projects across the Oracle Cloud Infrastructure console. Daily tasks include full stack development, testing, CI/CD, participating in scrum activities, and collaboration with Frontend Development, Support, Product Management, and other Service Teams.

**Required Skills**
BS degree in Computer Science or related fields or equivalent experience
  
  
3-5 years of experience in server technology development
  
  
Expert in multiple languages, including Java, Node.js, C++, Python
  
  
Expert in microservices frameworks such as Spring, Micronaut
  
  
Experience building interfaces, including JSON REST APIs
  
  
Experience with container-based deployment like Docker, Kubernetes
  
  
Experience with test frameworks like Postman/Newman, Junit
  
  
Expertise with JavaScript based frameworks like AngularJS, BackboneJS, which is a must
  
  
Good understanding of object-oriented JavaScript concepts, HTML5 and CSS along with responsive design
  
  
**Preferred Skills**
Very desirable to have AI skills like Prompt engineering, Training models, and LLM.
  
  
Experience with distributed source control, including GIT
  
  
Experience with build tools such as Gradle, Maven
  
  
Experience with continuous deployment tools like Teamcity, Jenkins
  
  
Working experience within a Linux-based environment
  
  
Familiarity with log analysis tools and debugging tools
  
  
**Functional Qualifications:**
Hands-on experience with a public cloud platform like AWS, Azure, Oracle
  
  
Experience developing distributed, fault-tolerant applications
  
  
Experience with Agile Methodologies, specifically Scrum
  
  
Experience using ticket tracking systems such as JIRA
  
  
Ability to quickly pick up new languages and technologies
  
  
Self-driven, able to work independently on a project even while the design is evolving
  
  
Strong desire to stay on top of new technologies and services
  
  
Passionate about learning
  
  
Strong communication skills, including cross-team collaboration
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**:**
As a member of the software engineering division, you will apply basic to intermediate knowledge of software architecture to perform software development tasks associated with developing, debugging or designing software applications or operating systems according to provided design specifications. Build enhancements within an existing software architecture and occasionally suggest improvements to the architecture.
  
  
**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.

title: Sr Agentic Systems Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced Agentic Systems Engineer who is passionate about designing, building, and productionizing intelligent, autonomous systems powered by LLMs, AI agents, tool use, and modern orchestration frameworks. In this role, you will develop reliable agentic applications, RAG pipelines, and tool integrations within an established platform architecture—connecting AI agents to enterprise systems across multiple business use cases.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
  

* Build and ship AI-powered applications using Python and/or Node.js, working within established LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, etc.).
* Implement agentic workflows — multi-step, tool-using agents that call APIs, vector stores, and databases according to defined design patterns.
* Build and tune RAG pipelines for enterprise use cases.
* Integrate and extend NLP/NLU models, prompt templates, and embeddings for conversational, classification, and automation tasks.
* Build and maintain agent integrations with enterprise applications across multiple business use cases, via REST APIs, connector frameworks, or MCP-style tool registries.
* Write and maintain test cases and evaluation harnesses for agent behavior — tool-call accuracy, hallucination rate, and task completion.
* Implement evaluation frameworks and observability for LLM/agent systems, including tracing, prompt evaluation, failure analysis, and regression testing.
* Apply appropriate guardrails, access controls, validation, and safety mechanisms to ensure agents operate within defined boundaries.
* Work with SQL/NoSQL databases to manage structured and unstructured data pipelines feeding agent workflows.
* Contribute to full-stack delivery, connecting LLM backends to modern frontends.
* Operate within existing access-control, logging, and audit patterns for multi-tool agent systems; flag gaps to the architecture team rather than redesigning independently.

**Required Skills (Must Have)**

* 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 1–2 years hands-on building with LLMs or agentic frameworks.
* Strong proficiency in Python and/or Node.js for AI and backend development.
* Working knowledge of major LLM providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) and prompt orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph).
* Hands-on expertise in building LLM applications, including
* Prompt engineering and enforcing structured outputs
* Tool integration and function calling
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) using vector databases and embedding-based search
* Designing multi-agent workflows and orchestration frameworks
* Managing context windows and conversational state
* Experience integrating external tools and APIs via function calling or tool-registration mechanisms.
* Experience integrating agents or tools with enterprise SaaS applications via REST APIs or connector frameworks.
* Working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases and how they plug into AI pipelines.
* Experience writing test cases or evaluation harnesses for agent/LLM behavior (accuracy, hallucination, tool-call correctness).
* Familiarity with agent evaluation techniques, including LLM-as-a-judge, task-based evaluations, benchmark design, and automated regression testing.
* Understanding of access-control and audit-logging patterns in multi-tool, multi-agent systems.
* Understanding of AI security, prompt injection, data leakage, permission boundaries, and agentic-system guardrails.
* Strong debugging skills and the ability to implement complex multi-step systems within an established architecture.

Nice to Have Skills
  
  
  

* Understanding of cloud deployment and infrastructure (AWS, GCP).
* Knowledge of containerization and CI/CD pipelines (Docker, GitHub Actions).
* Experience with AI observability, guardrails, and safety mechanisms for LLMs.
* Familiarity with data warehouses or analytical query engines for large-scale structured retrieval.

**Lead Solution Architect- Bespoke Applications, Azure & Digital Modernization**
**Role family:**
Business Consulting / Solution Architecture
  
  
**Technology focus:**
Azure, web, mobile, APIs, microservices and integration
  
  
**Ideal Candidate**
A customer-oriented Lead Solution Architect who combines broad architectural thinking with hands-on engineering credibility. The candidate should be able to navigate from business problem to solution strategy, defend choices with senior stakeholders, and guide multidisciplinary teams toward a secure, scalable, supportable and commercially viable outcome.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
Own end-to-end architecture and presales solutioning for bespoke application engagements, translating business needs into secure, scalable and delivery-ready solutions across modern user experiences, cloud-native platforms, integration and application modernization.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Lead Solution Architect will provide technical and consulting leadership across complex bespoke application opportunities and transformation programs. The role combines customer-facing presales, application architecture, business and technical analysis, cloud-native engineering, estimation, migration planning and delivery governance. The successful candidate will shape pragmatic solutions that balance business outcomes, user experience, security, operability, cost, risk and delivery feasibility.
  
  
Application Solution Architect
  
  

* Lead customer discovery, architecture workshops, and solution definition from opportunity qualification through proposal, solution defence, and transition to delivery.
* Own end-to-end architecture across user experience, applications, APIs, integration, data, security, Azure cloud, DevSecOps, observability, and service management.
* Translate business and technical requirements into target architectures, modernization roadmaps, estimates, assumptions, dependencies, and delivery-ready artefacts.
* Assess legacy applications, technical debt, cloud readiness, and non-functional requirements; define rationalisation and migration strategies using the 6R approach.
* Design scalable web, mobile, microservices, event-driven, and cloud-native solutions, selecting technologies based on fit, maintainability, and delivery context.
* Lead RFI/RFP/RFQ solutioning, including technical proposals, effort and cost estimates, delivery models, presentations, proofs of concept, solution defence, and commercial clarifications.
* Guide design, development, migration, code reviews, testing, CI/CD, security, and resolution of complex engineering risks.
* Partner with sales, bid management, delivery, security, cloud, data, service, and commercial teams to ensure solutions are competitive, executable, and supportable.
* Establish architecture standards, reusable patterns, governance, and quality gates, and provide leadership through mobilisation and early delivery.
* Coach architects and engineering teams and contribute to reference architectures, accelerators, playbooks, and knowledge assets.

Core Technical Capabilities
  
  

* Application architecture: Layered and modular design, domain-driven principles, microservices, event-driven patterns, APIs, integration, and cloud-native design.
* Modernisation and migration: Application rationalisation, 6R assessments, technical-debt analysis, monolith decomposition, containerisation, migration sequencing, and roadmap development.
* Cloud and engineering: Azure hosting, serverless and container patterns, identity, data services, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, DevSecOps, automated testing, observability, SRE-aligned operability, and FinOps-aware decisions.
* Design and development: Responsive web and mobile solutions, accessibility, usability, design systems, coding practices, code reviews, testing strategy, and engineering-quality controls.
* Programming and frameworks: TypeScript, JavaScript, NativeScript, Angular, React, Flutter, Spring Boot, and Node.js.
* Analysis and delivery: Requirements elicitation, process and capability analysis, functional decomposition, NFR definition, dependency analysis, solution option assessment, backlog shaping, sprint planning, and Agile architecture governance.
* Architecture governance: Context, component, deployment, integration, data, security, and NFR views; decision records; traceability; architecture reviews; standards compliance; risk management; and handover criteria.

Leadership and Consulting Skills
  
  

* Excellent executive communication, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical decisions in business terms.
* Strong analytical, estimation, troubleshooting, and structured problem-solving capability, with clear articulation of trade-offs.
* Customer-focused and commercially aware, with an understanding of how architecture choices affect cost, risk, schedule, scalability, serviceability, and competitive positioning.
* Collaborative and credible across matrix teams, cultures, and time zones, with the ability to influence without authority and manage competing priorities.
* Strong ownership, adaptability, resilience, quality orientation, and the ability to coach architects and engineers.

**Experience And Qualifications**

* Significant experience in application solution architecture, bespoke software engineering, technology consulting, or an equivalent customer-facing role.
* Demonstrated experience designing and modernising enterprise applications across web, mobile, API, integration, and cloud platforms.
* Experience leading architecture and solutioning across presales and delivery, including estimation, proposal development, and transition to implementation.
* Practical understanding of Azure solution patterns, security, resilience, integration, DevSecOps, operational readiness, and Agile delivery.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Relevant cloud, architecture, Agile, project-management, or engineering certifications are desirable.

**Technology and Platform Exposure**
**Front end and mobile:**
Angular, React, Flutter, NativeScript, TypeScript, JavaScript, responsive design and accessibility.
  
  
**Back end and APIs:**
Spring Boot, Node.js, REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices, event-driven services and API management.
  
  
**Cloud and containers:**
Microsoft Azure, containers, Kubernetes, serverless services, platform services, hybrid integration and cloud governance.
  
  
**Integration and Middleware:**
API gateways, messaging, event streaming, enterprise integration patterns and service-to-service security.
  
  
**Engineering and delivery:**
Git-based engineering, CI/CD, automated testing, code quality, DevSecOps, Infrastructure as Code and environment strategy.
  
  
**Operations:**
Monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, resilience, backup/recovery, service readiness and support transition.

title: CMDB Analyst - ServiceNow, Discovery
description:
**Role Summary**
We are seeking an experienced CMDB Subject Matter Expert/Analyst to lead and improve our Configuration Management Database (CMDB) capabilities within the ServiceNow platform. This role will be responsible for CMDB governance, data quality, configuration item (CI) lifecycle management, ServiceNow Discovery, data integrations, reconciliation, and overall CMDB health.
  
  
The successful candidate will partner with infrastructure, ServiceNow application, endpoint, IT operations and platform teams to establish a trusted CMDB that supports IT service management, asset management, service mapping, operational reporting and technology risk management.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* CMDB Governance and Data Quality
* Define and maintain CMDB governance standards, policies, procedures and data ownership.
* Establish data quality controls to improve CI completeness, accuracy, consistency and compliance with defined standards.
* Monitor CMDB health dashboards, identify data quality issues and drive remediation with accountable teams.
* Define and track KPIs for CMDB health, data completeness, duplicate records, stale CIs and reconciliation accuracy.
* ServiceNow CMDB and Configuration Management
* Provide subject matter expertise across ServiceNow CMDB, the Common Service Data Model (CSDM), CI classes, relationships and lifecycle management.
* Maintain alignment with the enterprise data model and configuration management processes.
* Improve CI identification, classification, relationships and data normalization.
* Ensure CMDB data supports ITSM processes, incident, problem, change, asset management and service mapping.
* ServiceNow Discovery and Integrations
* Lead the assessment and improvement of ServiceNow Discovery, including discovery schedules, credentials, MID Servers, patterns and identification of discovery gaps.
* Troubleshoot missing, duplicate or inaccurate CI data and identify root causes across discovery sources.
* Manage and improve integrations with infrastructure, endpoint management, cloud and other data sources.
* Define and validate data-source precedence, reconciliation rules and Identification and Reconciliation Engine (IRE) behavior to prevent duplicate or incorrect CI updates.
* Data Reconciliation and Technical Troubleshooting
* Investigate CI identification, reconciliation, relationship and data ingestion issues.
* Establish clear source-of-truth rules for different CI attributes and data domains.
* Partner with ServiceNow platform administrators and infrastructure teams to resolve technical issues.
* Assess the downstream impact of CMDB data quality issues on IT operations, ITAM and reporting.
* Stakeholder Management and Continuous Improvement
* Work with global infrastructure, application, cloud, endpoint, security, ITSM and ITAM teams to improve data ownership and accountability.
* Develop CMDB improvement roadmaps, remediation plans and governance reporting.
* Provide technical guidance, documentation and knowledge transfer to internal teams and implementation partners.
* Drive continuous improvement and ensure changes follow established testing, approval and release processes.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* 9+ years of relevant experience in IT Service Management, CMDB, configuration management or ServiceNow platform engineering.
* Strong hands-on experience with ServiceNow CMDB and configuration item data models.

* Strong understanding of CSDM, CI classes, relationships, identification rules, reconciliation rules and IRE.
* Experience with integrations and data imports, including source mapping, transformation, data validation and reconciliation.
* Demonstrated ability to diagnose complex data quality issues and implement sustainable remediation.
* Experience establishing CMDB governance, data ownership, KPIs and operational reporting.
* Strong stakeholder management, analytical, problem-solving and communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).
* Relevant ServiceNow CIS certification, such as Discovery or ITSM, where applicable.
* Experience with Service Graph Connectors, cloud discovery, infrastructure integrations and service mapping.
* Familiarity with ITAM processes and the relationship between CMDB configuration items and hardware/software asset records.
* Experience working with global teams and implementation partners.

**Success Measures**

* Improved CMDB health and data quality scores.
* Reduced duplicate, stale, incomplete and incorrectly classified CIs.
* Improved Discovery coverage and accuracy.
* Improved CI relationship integrity and adherence to CSDM standards.
* Reduced recurring reconciliation and integration failures.
* Clear data ownership, measurable remediation progress and sustainable CMDB governance.

title: Sr Agentic Systems Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced Agentic Systems Engineer who is passionate about designing, building, and productionizing intelligent, autonomous systems powered by LLMs, AI agents, tool use, and modern orchestration frameworks. In this role, you will develop reliable agentic applications, RAG pipelines, and tool integrations within an established platform architecture—connecting AI agents to enterprise systems across multiple business use cases.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
  

* Build and ship AI-powered applications using Python and/or Node.js, working within established LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, etc.).
* Implement agentic workflows — multi-step, tool-using agents that call APIs, vector stores, and databases according to defined design patterns.
* Build and tune RAG pipelines for enterprise use cases.
* Integrate and extend NLP/NLU models, prompt templates, and embeddings for conversational, classification, and automation tasks.
* Build and maintain agent integrations with enterprise applications across multiple business use cases, via REST APIs, connector frameworks, or MCP-style tool registries.
* Write and maintain test cases and evaluation harnesses for agent behavior — tool-call accuracy, hallucination rate, and task completion.
* Implement evaluation frameworks and observability for LLM/agent systems, including tracing, prompt evaluation, failure analysis, and regression testing.
* Apply appropriate guardrails, access controls, validation, and safety mechanisms to ensure agents operate within defined boundaries.
* Work with SQL/NoSQL databases to manage structured and unstructured data pipelines feeding agent workflows.
* Contribute to full-stack delivery, connecting LLM backends to modern frontends.
* Operate within existing access-control, logging, and audit patterns for multi-tool agent systems; flag gaps to the architecture team rather than redesigning independently.

**Required Skills (Must Have)**

* 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 1–2 years hands-on building with LLMs or agentic frameworks.
* Strong proficiency in Python and/or Node.js for AI and backend development.
* Working knowledge of major LLM providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) and prompt orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph).
* Hands-on expertise in building LLM applications, including
* Prompt engineering and enforcing structured outputs
* Tool integration and function calling
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) using vector databases and embedding-based search
* Designing multi-agent workflows and orchestration frameworks
* Managing context windows and conversational state
* Experience integrating external tools and APIs via function calling or tool-registration mechanisms.
* Experience integrating agents or tools with enterprise SaaS applications via REST APIs or connector frameworks.
* Working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases and how they plug into AI pipelines.
* Experience writing test cases or evaluation harnesses for agent/LLM behavior (accuracy, hallucination, tool-call correctness).
* Familiarity with agent evaluation techniques, including LLM-as-a-judge, task-based evaluations, benchmark design, and automated regression testing.
* Understanding of access-control and audit-logging patterns in multi-tool, multi-agent systems.
* Understanding of AI security, prompt injection, data leakage, permission boundaries, and agentic-system guardrails.
* Strong debugging skills and the ability to implement complex multi-step systems within an established architecture.

Nice to Have Skills
  
  
  

* Understanding of cloud deployment and infrastructure (AWS, GCP).
* Knowledge of containerization and CI/CD pipelines (Docker, GitHub Actions).
* Experience with AI observability, guardrails, and safety mechanisms for LLMs.
* Familiarity with data warehouses or analytical query engines for large-scale structured retrieval.
